posts.title: Staying Sharp: The Fear That AI Would Make Me Soft
posts.description: When I first started setting up AI assistants to help run my day, I had a quiet worry in the back of my head: Is this going to make me less sharp? We have all seen what happens when you hand a mental muscle over to a tool. Once you rely on turn-by-turn GPS for every drive across town, your internal map starts to fade. posts.title: The Imaginary Tomorrow
posts.description: "Retirement starts when you stop sacrificing today for some imaginary tomorrow." — Naval Ravikant I used to think retirement was a date.
